items.title: Gingerbread Train Carrying Candy
items.alt: Gingerbread locomotive with a teal cab roof and peppermint wheels pulling a small wagon filled with striped candy sticks.
items.description: White icing seams and red-and-green candies trace the engine and the fully connected sweet-filled wagon.

items.title: Gingerbread Camper Trailer
items.alt: Rounded gingerbread camper with two peppermint wheels, striped window awnings and a brown arched door decorated with a wreath.
items.description: White icing curls and candy berries frame the amber windows above a small front step and exposed tow hitch.

items.title: Gingerbread Animal Carousel
items.alt: Gingerbread carousel with a reindeer, horse and bear beneath a red-and-green candy canopy topped by a gold star.
items.description: Peppermint trim and white icing scrolls decorate the round base around the three different suspended animal cookies.

items.title: Floral Gingerbread Teapot
items.alt: Round gingerbread teapot decorated with pink floral icing, white scrolls and a scalloped lid topped by a small cookie knob.
items.description: The broad open handle and upward-curving spout frame the raised flower and green leaves on the side.

items.title: Gingerbread Cookies in a Heart Gift Box
items.alt: Open heart-shaped gift box holding four different smiling gingerbread cookies, with a ribboned lid resting behind it.
items.description: The star, tree, heart and round character cookies sit in individual paper liners inside the cream-and-red box.

items.title: Icing a Gingerbread Star
items.alt: Star-shaped gingerbread cookie edged with white icing beside a piping bag and two bowls of red and green frosting.
items.description: The metal piping tip touches the cookie border, with the colored frosting bowls placed above the star.
